about_the_game:
🔥 What’s Inside (Besides You):

  • 100+ Lewd Anime Puzzles
    Each puzzle features a unique, high-resolution hentai image. From soft seduction to intense encounters, the art is detailed, uncensored, and absolutely doujin-approved.

  • 3 Categories of Peak Culture

    • Fantasy & Sci-Fi: Space elves, magic users, cyber waifus—you name it.

    • Monster Girls: Foxgirls, catgirls, lamias, succubi—your favorites are all here.

    • Fun With Friends: Flirty threesomes and close encounters with your waifu.

  • 3 Difficulty Levels (~50 pieces, ~100 pieces, ~170 pieces)
    Whether you’re in for a quick tease or a long session, we’ve got you covered.

  • Optional Rotation (Turn Her Around 😉)
    Turn on piece rotation for an extra challenge or keep it chill—your waifu, your rules.

  • Snap-To-Place Puzzle System
    Correctly placed pieces snap into place like destiny itself.

  • Progress Saving
    Walk away from your puzzle mid-session and come back when the mood strikes. Your progress stays right where you left it.

  • Lewd Reveals
    Finish a puzzle to unlock the full uncensored artwork. No outlines. No distractions. Just her.

  • Steam Achievements
    A handful of cheeky goals await you. (Yes, we’re tracking how many waifus you have.)

👀 For the Cultured Only

Fragments of Waifu is for those who’ve stared at a loading screen thinking “I could marry her,” and who believe every puzzle deserves a waifu at the center.

This is a safe space for fans of fan service. A shrine to the unashamed. A puzzle game where every piece brings you closer to… enlightenment.

🔞 Adults Only

This game contains uncensored hentai, full nudity, and explicit sexual content. All characters are fictional, 2D, and 18+. There is no censorship option, and there never will be. We know what you’re here for.
